title: Jis ka Nahi Ghadeer Pe Emaan Ya Ali
body:
Jis Ka Nahi Ghadeer Pe Emaan Ya Ali
Jis ka nahi Ghadeer pe emaan ya Ali
Kaise my usko maano musalman ya Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Wo jo huwa tha barsare maidaan ya ali
Behroon ne bhi suna tha wo ailaan ya ali
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Utaah wo kehke laash e Salman ya ali
Niklegi kaise aise meri jaan ya ali
<<DIVIDER>>
3. ALLAH Sarfaraz rakhe unko ta-abad
Hum aaj jinke ghar me hai mehman ya ali
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Dushman hai tera jo bhi wo ibne qaseer hai
Tere liye Nabi ka hai farmaan ya Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Kadmo me hai pade huwe jiske tamaam taaj
Hain aap us Hussain ke Sultan ya Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Khushbu Najaf ki aati us sar Zameen se
Jaata hu jab main Shehr e Khurasan ya Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Maidaan se bhaag jane ka jinka plan tha
Qambar ne unse le liye paaran ya Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Salman bole mimber e paalan dekh kar
Aisa kaha tha Taqt e Sulaiman ya Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Thanda kiya hai aapka dil jisne mai use
Karne Salam jaunga kashaan ya Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
10. Kausar ki aayate teri zauja ki rukshati
Zahra hai tera Surah e Rahman ya Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
11. Khanjar uthaye hath me qatil hai bad hawas
Mesum nahi zara bhi pareshan ya Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
12. Adam se taba Isa hai sab hi qataar me
Rakh le hame kahi pe bhi darmaan ya Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
13. Dosh e Rasul e Paak pe phir jalwa gar ho aap
Phir todne hai konse Bhagwaan ya Ali
